plugins.name: mentor
plugins.description: A lean planning harness: a marker-driven edit gate keeps the repo read-only until a Mermaid-first Markdown plan is approved, then implementation runs subagents-first (SDD). Ships staged plan review, plan splitting with per-plan build state, session handoff/resume, published review tours, and /mentor:zoom — local topic × perspective HTML views of any subject, no plan required.

plugins.name: sdlc-mini
plugins.description: Turbo SDLC helpers: a release-notes generator and a tidy commit helper. Manifest and env-config setup have moved to the devflow plugin; init-turbo-manifest and init-turbo-env-config remain as deprecated redirects.

plugins.name: loom
plugins.description: Session harvesting and plugin lifecycle tools: harvest every un-harvested session of a project into reusable artifacts one session at a time (auto-folded; --review to confirm), audit a plugin from one session, learn from every session that used a plugin and auto-implement reviewed improvements, opt in to usage tracking, schedule daily unattended harvest+learn runs, onboard new users, and publish releases with synced manifests.
